sections.text:
Steps to Prepare for
Relay Testing
Obtain outage for generator protected by this relay.
Obtain copy of Relay setting from field maintenance file.

Check that the two bus disconnecting switches are opened and tagged
from two sides.

Inspect the CT secondary circuits and all cabling supplying the relay
including matching CT.

sections.text: This procedure is used to perform offload relay testing.
Check there is no AC current from CT's by using a clamp ampere.

items: This procedure is used to perform offload relay testing.
Check there is no AC current from CT's by using a clamp ampere.
Inject the current to points ( A3,A4 ) for phase R for first side.

Increase the injected current gradually till the red
 flags of the injected phases appear then record the pick up value .

Inject current greater than pick up value then
 decrease injected current gradually until the red flag disappear then
 record the reset value .

Inject the current to point (B3,B4) for phase R for second
 side .

Increase the injected current gradually till the red
 flag of the injected phases appear then record the pick up value .

Inject current greater than pick up value then
 decrease injected current gradually until the red flag disappear then
 record the reset value .

Repeat the pervious steps from 1 to 6 for phase S but
 the injected current to points (A5,A6) first side, (B5,B6) second
 side .

Repeat the pervious steps from 1 to 6 for phase T but
 the injected current to points (A7,A8) first side, (B7,B8) second
 side

Check the return of relay- wires and trip-flags to
 their original places and tighten them carefully.

Be sure that the relay is completely ready for
 service any time.
Return the work permission.

Introduction

Safety 
Precautions
The equipment isolation is required.

Testing Procedures
Inject the current to points ( A3,A4 ) for phase R for first side.
Increase the injected current gradually till the red
 flags of the injected phases appear then record the pick up value .
Inject current greater than pick up value then
 decrease injected current gradually until the red flag disappear then
 record the reset value .
Inject the current to point (B3,B4) for phase R for second
 side .
Increase the injected current gradually till the red
 flag of the injected phases appear then record the pick up value .
Inject current greater than pick up value then
 decrease injected current gradually until the red flag disappear then
 record the reset value .
Repeat the pervious steps from 1 to 6 for phase S but
 the injected current to points (A5,A6) first side, (B5,B6) second
 side .
Repeat the pervious steps from 1 to 6 for phase T but
 the injected current to points (A7,A8) first side, (B7,B8) second
 side
Returning the Relays to Service
Check the return of relay- wires and trip-flags to
 their original places and tighten them carefully.
Be sure that the relay is completely ready for
 service any time.
Return the work permission.
